meta.name: false-green-tests
meta.description: Find out why the tests pass but the app is broken. Catches false greens: a green suite over a feature that does not work, a mocked API standing in for a real one, an assertion that holds no matter what the app does, a click handler wired to nothing. Use when the suite is green and the user says it is broken, when a test never fails, when coverage looks fine but bugs still ship, or before trusting a passing run you did not watch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查出测试全绿但功能其实坏掉的原因,避免假绿灯蒙混过关
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果测试明明全过,线上却还是出问题
copy.tagline_en: Find out why tests pass while the app is broken
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your tests are green but the app still fails.

howto.what: 它会运行真实应用,把应用的实际行为与测试的断言逐项对比,找出「假绿」:测试通过但功能并不工作。确认应用与测试矛盾后,它会改写那条漏掉问题的测试断言,而不是放宽检查。
howto.when: 当测试套件全绿但应用被报告损坏、某个测试从不失败,或覆盖率正常却仍有 bug 时;也用在信任一次你没亲自观察过的通过运行之前。

say.text: 测试全绿但这个功能点不工作,帮我查为什么
say.note: 它会在真实应用里执行动作并核对结果

say.text: 这个断言是不是根本不可能失败?
say.note: 检查只验证「没有报错」这类断言

say.text: 帮我扫一遍整个界面,看哪些地方没人测过
say.note: 返回异常清单和未覆盖的界面

howto.what_en: It runs the real app and compares what it does against what the test claims, catching false greens: a passing suite over broken behavior. It then rewrites the missed assertion instead of weakening checks.
howto.when_en: Use when the suite is green but the app is reported broken, when a test never fails, when coverage looks fine yet bugs still ship, or before trusting a passing run you did not watch.

say_en.text: The suite is green but this feature does not work, find out why
say_en.note: It acts in the real app and checks the outcome

say_en.text: Is this assertion even able to fail?
say_en.note: Checks assertions that only assert absence

say_en.text: Sweep the whole UI and show me what nobody exercised
